mapper.select:
/* master.mpif.selectMasterMpIfCowayChargeList */
SELECT SUBSTR(A.CLOSE_MONTH,1,4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.CLOSE_MONTH,5,2) AS CLOSE_MONTH, A.BUYER, B.COM_NAME_LOC, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.LEGACY_USER_ID, C.USER_NAME_LOC, A.AMOUNT, A.CMITM, CASE WHEN A.CMITM = '5038' THEN '명함공제' WHEN A.CMITM = '5052' THEN '필터공제' ELSE '입력오류' END AS CMITM_NAME, C.DEPARTMENT AS DEPT_CODE, D.TEXT1 AS DEPT_NAME, E.BUYER_ITEM_NO, E.DESCRIPTION, A.IF_FLAG, A.IF_MSG FROM COWAY_ZHR_WEB127 A , ICOMCMPY B , ICOMLUSR C , ICOMCOD2 D , ICOMPODT E WHERE 1 = 1 AND CLOSE_MONTH = #{YYYYMM}
AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE
AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = C.LEGACY_USER_ID
AND 'C001' = D.TYPE(+) AND C.DEPARTMENT = D.CODE(+) AND C.COM_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE(+)
AND A.BUYER = E.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = E.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = E.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.CMITM, A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ
mapper.update: INSERT INTO COWAY_ZHR_WEB127 ( BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, LEGACY_USER_ID, AMOUNT, ADD_DATE, CMITM, CLOSE_MONTH ) ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, #{LEGACY_USER_ID} AS LEGACY_USER_ID, #{AMOUNT} AS AMOUNT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, #{CMITM} AS CMITM, #{CLOSE_MONTH} AS CLOSE_MONTH FROM ICOMPODT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND A.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND ROWNUM = 1 )
